reviews.comment: I've never taken statistics or a computer science class before this and still got an A. You don't need biology for this class at all. The tests are worth an insane amount, study hard for them. The final is the hardest and at 35% of your grade can be the difference between an A and a B. Lectures are slow, but go to them. He's really nice as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: For those of you who don't even know what this class is, it's basically a coding class. You use a program called R coding and you basically are solving statistics problems using this program. Don't worry he gives you a tutorial that you need to complete to learn the system. Also dw but you don't need a deep level of statistics understanding either.

The content in this class is not super hard, but the class grading is a little harsh. 25% HW, 20% Midterms 1 and 2, and 35% for the Final. The final being so heavy is what was most stressful. I attended every lecture and it is pretty hard to stay focused but the lectures did help me understand things. The pacing during lectures is slow at times.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Exams are most of your grade other than HWs, they are online through honorlock but can use any material on your laptop including notes/hw etc. Good lecturer the class is just long so sometimes hard to stay focused for over an hour lol. He posts notes for each unit on canvas. Helpful guy if you have any questions. Would def recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class, He made it way easier than other professors. Only advice is prepare for final, it is harder than the other tests, it is more in depth. I wouldve had A if I had studied for Final more. But hes super nice and if you go to class he makes it very easy to learn. I really really reccomend him!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Super great guy, his lectures are all you need to know for the exams and they are open note so as long as you pay attention in class and copy down the example script he gives during lecture you will be fine. his notes are awesome and he even does coding labs outside class that help go to them !
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not many grades so you need to do well on the exams, but they should be pretty straightforward if you can do the homeworks easily. Dr. Zhou is incredibly nice and responded very quickly to my emails.
Lecture can be tedious but it is good to attend! Averages are usually high but I personally struggled when I would not pay attention or miss consecutive lectures! Fair grader and super kind prof!

Dr. Zhou is probably the best prof I've had at TAMU. His lectures are really easy to understand. He provides detailed solution notes on HW, emphasizing understanding more than memorizing for a grade. His midterms are online and open-note, which motivates you to learn the material and not just memorize it. Highly recommend for STAT312!!

He is super clear on what needs to be learned and is really understanding. His lecture slides are really all you need to prepare for the exams, which are done online and open note. Definitely the best statistics professor I've had!
Honestly, I just like watching him do his little hops and jumps while teaching. It makes me happy :)

I had him for STAT 436, and I loved the class. I learned a lot and he does a good job of explaining the concepts. He's very open to questions and good at answering them. I liked how the course was structured. The homeworks are relevant to the material being taught and the exams. I highly recommend Dr. Zhou and STAT 436.

Dr. Zhou is really nice and understanding. It's a difficult class, but he explains everything you need to know in class and is easy to approach for office hours or questions. Exams are easy if you go to lectures and pay attention

He is easy to understand and is quite clear on what you need to know for the class. The lectures are a good source for doing the homework, however, you can just use the powerpoints/R codes he uploads to determine how to do the problems. There are about 10 homework and 2 exams. The Homeworks are base on lectures and the exams are like homework.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is the best prof i've had at tamu. You can learn everything necessary from his slides, the lectures are just a plus. He answers emails really quickly. The best part is his attitude towards talking about hw. Aggie honor code is a scare tactic, he let us help each other as long as the work was original, so I learned so much from my peers.
